## Description

Addendum composer on a signed note creates a new signed version (amends_version_id, reason) with the same sign flow; version history lists v1, v2… with signer and time. Print/PDF: A4, header with patient name, MRN and DOB on every page, signer block, version, "Corrections are added as signed addenda".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An addendum never alters v1; viewing shows the original plus addenda in order.
- [ ] **AC2.** Addendum requires a reason and step-up authentication.
- [ ] **AC3.** PDF renders server-side with MRN/DOB on every page and is stored with hash.
- [ ] **AC4.** Print view passes screen-reader and 200 % zoom checks.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
